origine_fr: Une main 扌 et 平, qui donnait le son mais se lit píng, loin de pēng. La main qui frappe. Elle est devenue la critique qui frappe, 抨击.
origine_en: A hand 扌 and 平, which gave the sound but is read píng, far from pēng. A hand that strikes. It became criticism that strikes, 抨击.

mots.en: to attack, to lash out at

phrase.zh: 报上有文章抨击这个计划。
phrase.pinyin: Bào shang yǒu wénzhāng pēngjī zhège jìhuà.
phrase.fr: Un article du journal attaque ce projet.
phrase.en: An article in the paper attacks this plan.
